scope: Official conceptual documentation plus local source schemas, source hashes and annual/panel equivalence on analytical columns; no claim of national estimates.

sources.organization: INEI - Centro de Investigación y Desarrollo
sources.title: Documento Metodológico de los Indicadores en Educación
sources.evidence: ENAHO examples use P308C for primary grade and P308B for secondary year; observed age-grade delay includes one-year difference. Some tables define narrower denominators than the project's 6-17 cohort. Resident filter also appears for NINI on PDF page 48.

sources.title: Alumnos con atraso escolar - ficha metodológica
sources.evidence: SIAGIE indicator uses an age difference of at least two years and age at 31 March. It is not interchangeable with age at interview.

sources.title: Encuesta Nacional de Hogares2025 - Diccionario de Datos
sources.evidence: Annual survey and panel/non-panel distinction. Codes for completed age, enrollment, attendance, level, year, grade and internet use in preceding month. Missing codes require exclusion from target calculation. P314B records locations/devices, P316$1..12 internet purposes, P316B/C conditional self-reported digital activities for age14+, not a universal assessed competence score. Person expansion FACPOB07 and annual education population FACTORA07 are distinct from household FACTOR07.

sources.title: ENAHO 2024 - Manual de Consistencia Básica
sources.evidence: Resident-person formula uses household member not absent 30 days or non-member present 30 days. This is a 2024 methodological reference, not a claim to have read a 2025 consistency manual.

sources.title: Sistema de Microdatos - presentación
sources.evidence: Annual2025 module01/02/03/34 ZIPs are locally available and were inspected directly; use manifests/hashes and source_comparison.json for analytical equivalence with panel2025.

sources.organization: INEI - materials supplied in instructor Drive download
sources.evidence: 2025-suffixed panel fields and categorical codes; some attendance labels retain outdated wording and should be checked against questionnaire.

sources.organization: INEI - materials supplied in instructor Drive download
sources.evidence: Enrollment and current attendance questions; CEBA; year/grade fields; internet-use question for age 6 plus and dependent follow-up branches. TIC competence block is conditional on age14+ and computer use; no-use/skips do not prove absence of skills.

sources.organization: INEI - materials supplied in instructor Drive download
sources.evidence: Membership, absence, presence and age; education-module administration universe differs from the narrower analytical residence filter.
